faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the {count} most common questions. Missing something?
faq.ctaDesc: If the answer isn't here, get in touch — we're happy to help.
faq.shippingQ1: How fast do you send orders out?
faq.shippingA1: Within 24 hours of confirmation, usually the same or the next business day. Once we hand the parcel to the carrier, you'll get an email with a tracking number.
faq.shippingA2: With Zásilkovna — either to a pickup point or Z-BOX, or by courier to your address. Delivery usually takes 1–2 business days, and you'll find current prices for both options on the Shipping & payment page.
faq.shippingQ3: Do you deliver to Slovakia too?
faq.shippingA3: For now we only ship within Czechia. Slovakia is on the way — we'll let you know once it's live.
faq.shippingQ4: What if my parcel doesn't arrive?
faq.shippingA4: If it hasn't shown up within 5 business days of dispatch, email us at info@slingr.cz or give us a call. We'll check with the carrier right away and sort it out.
faq.returnsQ1: How long do I have to return goods?
faq.returnsA1: 14 days from receipt, no reason needed. Just fill in the form on the Returns page and send the goods back to our address. Return postage is paid by the buyer.
faq.returnsQ2: What condition must returned goods be in?
faq.returnsA2: Unused, undamaged, complete with accessories and in the original packaging. Otherwise we may reduce the refund accordingly.
faq.returnsQ4: When will I get my money back?
faq.returnsA4: Within 14 days of the goods reaching us. We send the money back the same way the payment came in — to your card or bank account.
faq.paymentA1: By card online (Visa, Mastercard) or cash on delivery. Exactly what's on offer at the moment, and any surcharge, is shown during checkout and on the Shipping & payment page.
faq.paymentA2: Yes. The payment is handled by a certified gateway with 3D Secure, and your card number never passes through our servers.
faq.paymentQ3: When is the money taken from my account?
faq.paymentA3: With card payment, right after you confirm the order. With cash on delivery, only when you collect the parcel.
faq.productsQ1: What age are the slingshots suitable for?
faq.productsA1: We recommend them from age 6, with adult supervision for younger children. They fire only soft ammo — foam balls, water balloons or at foam cans — so with a few basic rules in place they won't hurt anyone.
faq.productsA2: Yes. We only sell soft, lightweight ammo (foam balls, water balloons) that doesn't hurt on impact. Common sense still applies — don't aim at anyone's face and don't use hard ammo from elsewhere.
faq.productsQ3: What are the slingshots made of and what can they take?
faq.productsA3: Durable plastic and quality elastic rubber, so they survive a whole afternoon of skirmishes and the usual drops in the garden. We test every model in action ourselves — if it doesn't survive our backyard battle, it doesn't make the lineup.
faq.productsA4: Sure. We sell spare balls, water balloons, targets and foam cans separately in the Ammo and Accessories categories, so you never run out mid-battle.
faq.supportQ1: How do I get in touch?
faq.supportA1: Email info@slingr.cz, call +420 605 000 887 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–2pm) or use the chat on the site. We usually reply within a few hours.
faq.supportQ2: How long will I wait for a reply?
faq.supportA2: We try to reply within 4 business hours. When questions pile up, we'll get back to you the next business day at the latest.
faq.supportA3: Yes. After dispatch you'll get an email with a tracking number. You can also check your order status any time on the Order status page — all you need is your order number and email.
faq.securityQ1: How do you protect my personal data?
faq.securityA1: We process it in line with GDPR and never pass it on for marketing. All communication with the site is encrypted. You'll find the details in the Privacy Policy.
faq.securityQ2: Do you store my card number?
faq.securityA2: No. We don't store card numbers and have no access to them. Payments are handled exclusively by a certified payment gateway with PCI DSS certification.

about.title: About us
about.heroDesc: A new online shop with kids' slingshots and everything for outdoor battles. Start a water war or a duel for the best aim and have fun outside.
about.storyTitle: Every kid today is hidden behind a screen.
about.storyPara1: We wanted to get kids away from screens and back into the garden. That's how Slingr was born — slingshots, soft ammo and water balloons you can use for a skirmish whenever you feel like it. No fuss, just endless fun and safe play.
about.storyPara2: Today we ship slingshots and ammo all across the Czech Republic. We test every product in action ourselves — whatever doesn't survive our backyard battle, we don't sell.
about.promiseTitle: What you can always count on
about.promise1Desc: We sell soft ammo and slingshots suitable for kids. Fun without bumps and bruises.
about.promise2Desc: We test every product ourselves in a backyard battle. Only the best ones make it to you.
about.promise3Desc: Clear prices, dispatch within 24 hours and 14 days to return. No hidden surprises.
about.founderQuote: I started Slingr to get kids away from screens and back outside — into the garden, into the action, among friends. I'd hand every product to my own kids without hesitation.
